title: harness-emitted-seed
responsibility: Adds to the synthetic history a unit built for two execution targets and takes it through a missing limit, a baseline, growth of one output while the other shrinks, an approval and an output that is no longer built.

inputs.name: seedEmitted.repo
inputs.description: Provides the synthetic repository that this seed mutates. It must support the writes, Harness commands, target setup, verification, and commits performed by the routine.

inputs.name: seedEmitted.verified
inputs.description: Callback invoked whenever the seed needs a verification result from the synthetic repository. It receives the same VerifyRepo and resolves to a VerifyOutcome whose record ID is used by budget commands.

inputs.name: seedEmitted.explain
inputs.description: Callback used to describe the behavior changes added to the unit history. It receives the VerifyRepo and a behavior string, and the awaited return value is ignored.

outputs.name: seedEmitted
outputs.description: Resolves to the commit IDs created for the emitting, packed, swapped, repacked, and vanished stages, in that order. Each value is the string returned by repo.commit for that stage.
